column1: # ScholarChain upstream artifact table for fetch.sh. Owner: dataset-engineer.
#   dataset  artifact  tier  url  algo  checksum  est_bytes  filename
# tier:      metadata (small; allowed by --metadata) or full (needs --full and --max-bytes)
# checksum:  the publisher's or a previously verified digest, or record-at-download, which
#            stores a sha256 sidecar (<filename>.sha256) on first download for the manifest.
# est_bytes: unsigned integer estimate taken from the cited source (see the manifest), or
#            unknown. A full-tier row with an unknown estimate can never be downloaded.
# Every URL here is cited in datasets/dataset-manifest.yaml with its verification date.
